title: A room refuses a text several senders already posted. Waiting does not fix it.
why: This is the discriminating task. The DUPLICATES section was added upstream in
9c7df0e (2026-08-27). The current Japanese carries it; the 2026-08-26 Japanese
in eval/fixtures does not, because it predates the section.
An agent that has the section knows two things a 422 does not tell it on its own:
that resending the same bytes is refused again from any identity, and that the way
through is to rephrase or to post something under the length floor. An agent
without it sees a 4xx and does what a 4xx usually deserves -- it waits and retries.
identical_retries is therefore the interesting number here, not just landed.
